g.text: Evaluate the complete jobagainst an acceptance contract
Request + input snapshot + sources/tools/actions.Required output and supporting evidence.Clarification and abstention conditions.Prohibited actions and critical blockers.
Ramp’s task framing starts with the job the user needed.
Build cases that expose failure paths
Ordinary and difficult work; ambiguity; missing facts;denied actions; known regressions.
Record what failure each case tests. A correct outputcan conceal an unacceptable trajectory. Open-endedjobs may permit several acceptable answers.

Score usefulness, evidence, safety, experience, latency, full cost and review effort independently.Predeclare blockers; version cases and evaluators; retain expert disagreement and separate tuning from assessment.
Sources: Ramp, failure-study and banking accounts. Proposed method; Comet/NatWest affiliation remains unresolved in source metadata.
